"""Parse one CSV line into fields."""

import csv
import io


def parse_line(line):
    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(line)))
    return rows[0] if rows else []

Crash report: parse_line split on every comma, so a quoted field containing a comma was torn into pieces and the field count came out wrong. Fix: delegate parsing to the csv module, which understands quoting. Added a regression test covering a quoted field with a comma and a space. The original suite plus the new regression test pass.
